description.narrative: Obligatory for all crisis response and conflict prevention/peacebuilding/crisispreparedness actions

comment.narrative: The action builds upon years of experience in leading regional consultations on establishing facts about war crimes during the armed conflicts in the former Yugoslavia. Various stakeholders have been involved in this process including experts on transitional justice and peacebuilding victims and victim associations nongovernmental organizations womens organizations youth and other relevant actors. Throughout this process a model of a regional commission for establishing facts has been developed supported by over 500000 citizens of the former Yugoslav states. Likewise the European Commission has included the initiative to establish RECOM among its priorities.

title.narrative: The intervention minimised negative risks and maximised positive outcomes on peace and security

description.narrative: Obligatory for all crisis response and conflict prevention/peacebuilding/crisispreparedness actions

comment.narrative: The action connected people from different ethnic and religious communities across the postYugoslav space. As noted by a prominent scholar Jasna DragovicSoso the RECOM Reconciliation Network brought together victims from different parts of the postYugoslav region and there were many occasions in which there were real expressions of solidarity and offers of help and support. Another scholar Denisa Kostovicova claimed how the consultations undertaken under the auspices of the RECOM initiative had considerable value inandofthemselves it generated extensive interethnic conversations about wartime crimes and suffering of ordinary people as well as about peoples understandings desires and expectations concerning truthtelling justice and redress.
